title: Seeds and Bulbs
seo_title: Year 2 Science: Seeds and Bulbs Worksheets (How Plants Grow)
standard_text: Observe and describe how seeds and bulbs grow into mature plants.
meta_desc: Free Year 2 science worksheets on seeds and bulbs: which plants grow from each, what seeds grow into, how a bean grows and measuring plant growth. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Seeds and bulbs grow into plants.
key_sub: Root first, then shoot, leaves, flowers and new seeds.
body_html:
How to think about it

Seeds and bulbs grow into plants.

  • A root grows down, then a shoot grows up.
  • Leaves open, flowers grow, then new seeds form.
  • Bulbs, like daffodils, have food stored inside.
Example

What grows first from a bean?

Down into the soil

Answer: a root

Example

Daffodil: seed or bulb?

Planted in autumn

Answer: a bulb

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the shoot grows before the root.
  • Thinking a bulb is a kind of seed.
  • Thinking an acorn grows into a conker tree.

faq.q: How does a seed grow into a plant?
faq.a: With water and warmth, a root grows down and a shoot grows up. Leaves open, the plant grows taller, flowers grow and new seeds form.

faq.q: What is the difference between a seed and a bulb?
faq.a: A seed is small and grows from a flower. A bulb is bigger and stores food underground. Daffodils, tulips and onions grow from bulbs.

faq.q: What grows first from a seed?
faq.a: The root grows first, downwards into the soil. Then a shoot grows up towards the light.
